items.summary:
While you're refreshing charts praying for a 10x that never comes...

A 20-year-old kid is sitting in his university dorm making $44,000 last month.

Not from trading.

Not from memecoins.

From Claude AI.

He barely works 2-3 hours a day.

He’s not a genius. He’s not special.

He just discovered one stupidly powerful prompt that turns your normal knowledge into high-ticket digital products people pay $1k + for.

$7,000 in his first week.

Full digital products. PDFs. Guides. Sold on autopilot.

While 99% of Crypto Twitter is stuck in the same dopamine loop of green candles and rug pulls...

The prompt is so simple it feels unfair.

Most people will read this, feel the hit of FOMO, then keep scrolling and do nothing.

This kid is building real, boring, recurring cash machines that print whether BTC is at 80k or 120k.

The worst part?

The prompt is so simple it feels unfair.

If you're tired of gambling your portfolio on hope...

Follow me.

I drop the raw, unfiltered alpha on AI money printers that actually work in this bull run.

What’s stopping you from building something like this right now?

Comment that you'll start and at least try it RIGHT NOW👇

10 hours later: $200 → $3,000

This isn’t a thought experiment. It’s not a demo reel. It’s running right now, while you read this

The agents are already here. Most people just haven’t noticed yet
